svg.text: 24 movies, one A100: the GPU timeline for each ingest path
Every kernel and every transfer the device executed, on one shared clock. Each lane is one complete 24-movie job.
seconds from process start (traced run; CUPTI inflates all lanes alike)
Movie 1 costs ~0.2 s more than the rest in both arms — SM clock ramps from 210 MHz (persistence mode is off) and the page cache is cold.
The nvcomp lane is not just shorter: it is denser. Same work, less wall, and the device is doing a larger share of it.
